pieces.Text: Once every 1d4 rounds as a standard action, a flying polyp can create a powerful blast of wind at a range of up to 120 feet. This blast of wind creates a sudden explosion of flesh-scouring wind in a 30-foot-radius burst. All creatures within this area take 14d6 points of bludgeoning damage, with a successful DC
Reflex save halving the damage. In addition, these winds can check or blow away creatures as if they were tornado- strength winds (Pathfinder RPG Core Rulebook 439).
